{{Quote|You think I'm not aware of what has happened, either with the Wookiees or my men? Every hour they hold that factory, it inspires others into thinking they can defy the Empire.|Helricks|<ref name="Wookiee Revolt">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Wookiee Revolt|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Helricks''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], Captain Helricks led a unit inside one of the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] factories when they encountered a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] factory workers within the [[magnogravitics plant]] in [[Labor Valley]]. The Wookiees quickly decimated the squad, and Helricks was forced to retreat. He tasked an Imperial strike team to eliminate the Wookiees.
